title: Empty space

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Use empty space to direct attention because crowding reduces the distinction between important elements.
strategic_value: Airy Helsinki compositions can make a few identity elements more noticeable and easier to read.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section explains that empty space can be white, colored or photographic and shows an airy layout.
practical_value: Remove competing elements and identify the quiet area that lets the main message stand out.

content_islands.name: Attention rationale
content_islands.spec: Explain what empty space does and the forms it can take.

content_islands.name: Airy spread
content_islands.spec: Show a pink/blue section page beside a white page with a narrow body-text column and substantial unused area.

ingredient.name: Empty space
ingredient.role: Direct attention and separate visual priorities.
ingredient.application: Leave quiet areas around selected elements; these may be colored backgrounds or calm photographic areas.
ingredient.scope: No numeric whitespace ratio is prescribed.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explicitly says empty space directs attention to visual elements.
reference_purposes.Application: The specimen demonstrates an airy layout and the text recommends fewer elements over crowding.
